conflicts.description: The 2026 proxy says 'Over the past four years, the Board has added three new members ... and two other, long-serving members retired.' The 8-Ks date the three additions to 2021-01-04 (Lozano), 2021-11-09 (Gorsky) and 2024-02-28 (Austin), so Lozano joined about five years before that proxy. Narrative only; dates recorded from the 8-Ks.

Levinson's role on 2026-09-01 rests on prospective wording: the April 2026 8-K says he 'will become Lead Independent Director on the Transition Date'. The 8-K/A (2026-09-01) confirms only the Cook and Ternus changes. Cook's Form 4 ('Executive Chair') and Ternus's Form 3 ('CEO') show the transition happened, and no later filing contradicts the Lead Independent Director change.

open_questions: Art Levinson's exact appointment date in 2000 is not stated in any filing. He was not among the directors elected at the 2000-04-20 annual meeting (e072) and is listed as a director since 2000 in the 10-K filed 2000-12-14 (e070). His automatic 10,000-share director options are dated August 14 (2004-08-14 Form 4, e075; the 2005-2009 grants are also dated August 14), and the Director Plan grants annual options on the fourth and later anniversaries of initial election (e074). That implies 2000-08-14, but it is an inference, so the start stays at year precision.

When Levinson's 'Co-lead Director' title began and ended is not stated. He is 'Director' in the 2005-03-15 proxy and 'Co-lead Director' in the 10-K filed 2005-12-01, so it began in 2005. The end is set to his appointment as Chairman (2011-11-15). Medium confidence.

Andrea Jung was also a 'Co-lead Director'. She is 'Director' in the 2009-01-07 proxy and 'Co-lead Director' in the 2009-12-23 preliminary proxy and the 2010 and 2011 proxies (e081, e082, e080), so it began in 2009. By the 2012-01-09 proxy she is 'Director' again (e083). No filing says when it ended (it may have been 2011-11-15, when Levinson became Chairman), so this role is left out of roles.

John Ternus (director since 2026-09-01) has no committee assignment, no formal independence determination and no proxy biography in any filing through 2026-10-02. His other public boards are therefore unknown (none are mentioned in the 8-K). The next proxy (expected around January 2027) should settle this.
No filing reports committee changes made at or after the 2026-09-01 leadership transition. The committee rosters reflect the 2026-01-08 proxy.
The 2026-04-20 8-K gives Ternus's appointment as 2026-04-17 (board action) with effect from 2026-09-01. The membership starts on the effective date.
Tim Cook was an officer filing Forms 3/4 long before joining the board. His first Form 3 was not retrieved; his CIK comes from a 2026 Form 4.
Exchange tier (e.g., Global Select Market) and the 1980-12-12 IPO date are not stated in any SEC filing reviewed.
Other-board lists are taken from Apple's bios as of each filing (2026 proxy for current directors, 2023 proxy for Bell and Gore). They were not checked against the other issuers' filings.

coverage.method: Current roster checked against the 2026 DEF 14A, the 2026-02-24 8-K Item 5.07, both Item 5.02 filings made after that proxy (8-K 2026-04-20 and 8-K/A 2026-09-01), the 2026 10-Qs, and every Form 3/4 filed through 2026-10-02.

Every DEF 14A from 2020 to 2026 and every 8-K/8-K/A with Item 5.02, 5.03 or 5.07 filed from 2020-01-01 to 2026-10-02 reviewed. The two departures (Bell, Gore) are dated by the 2024 annual meeting (8-K Item 5.07).

Start dates only, for current directors and for Bell and Gore, from appointment 8-Ks (2003-2015), Form 3s, and proxies/10-Ks back to 2000. Departures before 2020 (e.g., Iger, Campbell, Drexler, Jobs) were not researched.
